criteria.label: Joy and enjoyment
criteria.definition: Frequency and ready expression of joy, fun and delighted pleasure in ordinary life.
criteria.high_evidence: Readily feels and shows joy; finds ordinary life fun and expresses unguarded delight.
criteria.low_evidence: Rarely feels or shows delight; ordinary activities produce little fun or joyful pleasure.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Quiet pleasure counts if explicitly joyful; calmness or mere absence of distress alone does not.

criteria.label: Positive appraisal of life
criteria.definition: Loving life and attending to its bright or enjoyable side.
criteria.high_evidence: Expresses affection for living and readily notices positive aspects of ordinary life.
criteria.low_evidence: Finds little to love or appreciate in life and seldom sees a bright side.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Practical problem-solving, certainty that things will succeed, and low anxiety alone do not establish positive appraisal. Difficult events need not be denied.

criteria.label: Laughter and amusement
criteria.definition: Readiness to be amused and to laugh, including overt laughter.
criteria.high_evidence: Is easily amused and laughs freely across ordinary moments.
criteria.low_evidence: Is hard to amuse and seldom laughs, including when others find something funny.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Laughter from nervousness or courtesy alone is ambiguous. Audible laughter is retained content but lack of volume alone cannot erase explicit amusement.

criteria.label: Playful humor with others
criteria.definition: Joking around and amusing familiar people.
criteria.high_evidence: Often jokes, adds playful remarks and amuses friends.
criteria.low_evidence: Seldom jokes around or adds playful amusement with friends.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Number of friends, kindness, party attendance and verbal dominance alone do not substitute for humor; cruel humor can still be humor.

boundary_controls.definition: Following the experiment format differs from depicted preferences, effort, emotion, ability or duties.
External access, imposed roles and one-off conditions alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence still counts.

Positive affect is not inferred from low N3, low N1, social ease or high energy. E6 retains both experienced pleasure and overt humor/laughter. A serious public role or courteous smile alone is ambiguous.

evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

weighting_policy: Equal non-null criteria within a response (1/k); not item weighted. Each eligible question receives equal weight within its source. Primary bank links are coverage opportunities, not independent item observations.
